strings.210-ФЗ статья 7 Каждый раз не хватает но: 210-FZ Article 7 A new document is missing every time
strings.210-ФЗ, статья 11.2, часть 6. Срок рассм: Law No. 210-ФЗ, Article 11.2, part 6. The complaint consideration period; sending the reasoned reply has a separate deadline.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В имеющемся комплекте не подтверждены из: The available package confirms no rule changes, new errors, expired period or properly documented exception for an erroneous action. Article 7, part 1, clause 4 requires these circumstances to be checked, not automatic acceptance of yet another list.
strings.В отличие от первой лишней справки нужно: Unlike the first unnecessary certificate, this requires comparing two acceptance stages and the exceptions for a subsequent requirement, not just the document list.
strings.В учебных материалах первоначальный отка: In the training materials, the initial refusal concerns only a signature. After the defect was corrected, the package was accepted; the new requirement concerns unchanged documents. The rules have not changed, deadlines have not expired and no new errors have been identified. The legally prescribed formal notification from the director about an erroneous action is absent.
strings.Вы работаете в подразделении, обеспечива: You work in the unit supporting consideration of a complaint by the proper recipient. Prepare materials and a draft reasoned decision; do not assume the powers of the body providing the service. The case documents determine the specific recipient. This training service applies Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ; no other special federal procedure is specified.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Добавлена только подпись; иных новых док: Only the signature was added; there are no other new documents or new errors.
strings.Досудебная жалоба по главе 2.1 закона №: Pre-trial complaint under Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ
strings.Единый тридцатидневный порядок независим: A uniform thirty-day procedure regardless of subject matter
strings.Заранее объявить незаконным любое послед: Declare every subsequent requirement unlawful in advance, even if the law changes.
strings.Каждый раз не хватает нового документа ·: A new document is missing every time · checking the basis
strings.Каждый сотрудник вправе заново определят: Every employee may redefine the required package without explanation.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Какой первоначальный недостаток был устр: Which original deficiency was corrected? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения жалобы на ново: Final day for reviewing the complaint about the new requirement
strings.Любое требование после первого отказа за: Any requirement after the first refusal is prohibited without exception.
strings.Менялись ли правила или прежние документ: Have the rules or the earlier documents changed?
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью об ограничениях на истреб: Find the article limiting document demands and specifying permitted submission methods. Calculate the complaint period separately.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
Do not assume that a new defect exists.
strings.Не читать уведомление, потому что первон: Do not read the notification because the original requirement was unjustified.
strings.Немедленное удовлетворение любого требов: Immediate satisfaction of every demand without verification
strings.Нет, всё осталось прежним; сроки их дейс: No, everything remains the same; the documents have not expired.
strings.Новое требование требует проверки предус: A new requirement calls for checking the prescribed exceptions; late discovery alone does not justify endlessly changing the list.
strings.Нужно проверять предусмотренные исключен: Check the prescribed exceptions and how they are documented instead of imposing an absolute prohibition.
strings.Обжалуется новое требование работника МФ: The complaint challenges a new requirement by an MFC employee after accepting the resubmitted package, not refusal to accept documents or correction of the service result.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Обязать заявителя исполнять любой новый: Oblige the applicant to fulfil any new list without reasons being given.
strings.Отклонить жалобу до исполнения всего нов: Reject the complaint until the entire new list is fulfilled
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Оценить новое подтверждение предусмотрен: Assess the new evidence of a prescribed exception and require clear grounds for the specific list; neither ignore the new document nor accept it as unlimited permission.
strings.Первоначально выявленный недостаток устр: The initially identified defect has been corrected.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Подготовить мотивированный вывод о новом: Prepare a reasoned conclusion on the new requirement
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение руководителем М: Prepare a review by the MFC director, checking the original list and whether a specific lawful exception exists.
strings.Помощник: «Закон никогда не позволяет ут: Assistant: “The law never allows document requirements to be clarified after the first refusal.”
strings.После первого отказа я исправил единстве: After the first refusal, I corrected the only error listed. Now, after accepting the package, they have given me a new list. The original documents have not changed in the meantime. The employee says, “We only noticed it now.”
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Появились ли ошибки в новом документе?: Have errors appeared in a new document?
strings.Признать устную фразу достаточным подтве: Accept a verbal phrase as sufficient proof of any exception
strings.Проверить по материалам каждое применимо: Check every applicable exception against the materials
strings.Проверить, что в процессе не появляется: Check that another unauthorised barrier does not arise in the process
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сообщить заявителю обоснование и дальней: Tell the applicant the grounds and next steps without additional arbitrary conditions
strings.Сопоставить новое требование с первым от: Compare the new requirement with the first refusal and check the specific exception instead of replacing it with the employee's discretion.

Compare the new requirement with the first refusal and check the specific exception, rather than substituting an employee's discretion for it. Unlike the first unnecessary-certificate case, the two intake stages and exceptions permitting a subsequent requirement must be compared, not just the document list.
strings.Сопоставить первый отказ, исправление и: Compare the first refusal, the correction and the new list
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Ссылка «заметили позже» не заменяет пред: Saying “we noticed it later” does not replace a prescribed exception.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Считать любой подписанный документ разре: Treat any signed document as permission to demand anything.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.Только отсутствие подписи на заявлении,: Only the missing signature on the application; I have now signed it.
strings.Только устной фразой сотрудника. Письмен: Only an employee's verbal statement. There is no written notification from the director about a documented error.
strings.Участник вымышленной учебной ситуации: Participant in a fictional training situation
strings.Учебное продолжение. Поступило уведомлен: Training continuation. A notification arrived from the director describing a documented erroneous action, with an attachment. It does not explain which information is now required.

strings.Часть возможных исключений не подтвержда: Some possible exceptions are not supported.
